svg.aria-label: Detailed flow diagram of the job-search engine. Setup.md is filled in once; ops holds session memory, read at the start of every session and written at the end. A knowledge base of four minimum files feeds a discovery track (crawler pulling from Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, and HN) and a build track (dossier, resume plus cover letter, outreach drafts, each showing its real sub-parts), both converging on a grounding gate with two rows: five checks on this one dossier's content, and three checks that run repo-wide every session regardless of dossier, also enforced automatically from the harness. A passing draft goes to two human-approval steps, filling the real form via an isolated browser tool and sending outreach via LinkedIn, that the person themselves submits or sends. A failing draft loops back to Build. The outcome, status, sponsorship, and next action, feeds back into the tracker.
svg.text: SESSION MEMORY: READ FIRST, WRITTEN LAST

g.text: EVERY CLAIM MUST TRACE TO A SOURCE, OR IT IS CUT
ALSO ENFORCED REPO‑WIDE, EVERY SESSION, FROM THE HARNESS ITSELF, NOT JUST THIS DOSSIER
gated the same way as the résumé
GATE FAILS → KICKED BACK TO BUILD
A HUMAN, NOT THE AGENT, MUST ACT
